mission.title: Poor Winners
mission.description: Dig through Zion and Machine records for the truth about the attack on Niobe.

phase.briefing:
{player}, I can't tell you how long it's been since I've been this happy. I'm sure that by now, even you've heard about this whole little Anome escapade? Delightful, isn't it? The greed, the betrayal... I almost get a little choked up just thinking about it.
And poor, poor Niobe, struck down by one of her so-called allies. I can't think of anything to make this predicament any better.
Well... maybe one thing. I want to know more! More details, more eyewitness accounts! And I know just the person to get them for me. I'm sending you to snoop through some Zion computer records. Be discreet.

enter.say: Well, you heard him. Find a computer in here and get the goods on that meeting.

done.say: Sounds like this just got one step stranger!

phase.briefing:
My, my, my! Now Niobe is trapped, and Zion can't reach her! I take back my previous statement. This could get better. It could get a lot better.
I think you'd better go pay this Dobrovoleva a little visit. I do hope he proves to be talkative.

enter.say: This is where Dobrovoleva is supposed to be. Better get that info off him, however you can.

talk.say: Hey, I already talked to somebody about this. The elevator wouldn't go to her floor, the stairs just ended, what more do you need?

done.say: Who are you, anyway? Tyndall didn't really mention you.

phase.briefing:
Elevators won't go to the floor, stairs just end; I wouldn't be surprised if a black cat walked by as well. It sounds just like some trick the Machines might pull, but why? What do they stand to gain from shutting Niobe off from the world?
Time to extend your eavesdropping to the Toasters. I've picked out a nice little location for you; take a look at their communication logs and see what they're up to in all this.

enter.say: There should be three computers in here. Make sure you check all of them.

mission.finish:
Looks like a mixed bag there; an obvious statement of fact, some sort of old message, but that one about the vials? Very interesting. No wonder the Machines wanted that case back so bad -- think what someone with more imagination than that fool Anome could do with them!
I would insult you, but I'm simply too happy right now to care. Call me later. I'm sure I'll be able to muster up some sort of abuse.
